+"""Update the version of FastAPI and add the release date."""
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+VERSION_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prepare a new release of FastAPI")
+    parser.add_argument("version", help="The new version to set (e.g., 0.137.0)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    version = args.version
+
+    # Update version in fastapi/__init__.py
+    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
+    if not re.search(rf'__version__ = "{version}"', content):
+        print(f"Updating version to {version} in {VERSION_FILE}...")
+        new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+        VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
+    else:
+        print(f"Version {version} already set in {VERSION_FILE}")
+
+    # Add release date to release-notes.md
+    print("Adding release date to release-notes.md...")
+    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"])
+    
+    if result.returncode == 0:
+        print("Release preparation complete!")
+    else:
+        print("Failed to add release date. Make sure the version header exists in release-notes.md", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+from rich.console import Console

+

+    console = Console(width=100)
+    
+    # Case 1: line_numbers=False, no code_width, padding
+    syntax = Syntax("print('hello')", line_numbers=False, padding=(0, 0, 0, 5))
+    measure = syntax.__rich_measure__(console, console.options)
+    # Expected: 
+    # padding = 5 + 0 = 5
+    # lines = ["print('hello')"] (len 13)
+    # width = 0 + 5 + 13 = 18
+    # min_width = 0 + 5 = 5
+    print(f"Case 1: {measure}")
+    assert measure.minimum == 5
+    assert measure.maximum == 18
+
+    # Case 2: line_numbers=True, no code_width, padding
+    syntax = Syntax("print('hello')", line_numbers=True, padding=(0, 0, 0, 5))
+    measure = syntax.__rich_measure__(console, console.options)
+    # Expected:
+    # _numbers_column_width = 1 + 2 = 3 (1 digit + 2 default padding)
+    # padding = 5 + 0 = 5
+    # lines = ["print('hello')"] (len 13)
+    # width = 3 + 5 + 13 + 1 (space) = 22
+    # min_width = 3 + 5 = 8
+    print(f"Case 2: {measure}")
+    assert measure.minimum == 8
+    assert measure.maximum == 22
+
+    # Case 3: line_numbers=False, code_width=10, padding
+    syntax = Syntax("print('hello')", line_numbers=False, code_width=10, padding=(0, 0, 0, 5))

+    print(f"Case 4: {measure}")
+    assert measure.minimum == 8
+    assert measure.maximum == 19
+

+    test_syntax_measure()
